dedupe_keys.name: annual co2 emissions from regulated installation operators england eu ets installations

description: This Environment Agency dataset lists the annual emissions, in tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent, of installations in England regulated under the EU Emissions Trading Scheme with a greenhouse gas emissions permit. The Excel workbook (about 350 KB) has one sheet per year from 2013 to 2020, each with roughly 700 to 770 installations, and gives emitter ID, permit ID, operator name, installation name, status, installation category, emitter type and reportable emissions. It is released under the Open Government Licence (attribution © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2016) and downloaded free from the Environment Agency data service; the data.gov.uk entry lists annual updates, with the last revision dated April 2023. Coverage is England only. Caveats: no coordinates or addresses are included, so sites must be matched through permit IDs or names; the series stops at 2020, when the UK left the EU ETS; and the file covers stationary installations only. For simulation it gives plant-level emissions for power stations, refineries, steel, cement, chemicals and other large industry, useful to size industrial energy demand and decarbonisation or carbon capture scenarios. Related catalogue records include the EU ETS Union Registry, the UKCS carbon storage licences and the Pollution Inventory (England).
